external payable deposit(uint256,bool): applies interest/rewards, credits deposit amount and pulls tokens via _transferFrom
external withdraw(uint256,bool): applies interest, computes max withdrawable and sends tokens via _transfer
external borrow(uint256,bool): applies interest, computes max borrowable and sends tokens out via _transfer
external payable repay(uint256,bool): applies interest, reduces borrow amount and pulls tokens via _transferFrom
external payable reserveDeposit(uint256): increases reserve/deposit totals and pulls tokens from msg.sender
onlyOwner reserveWithdraw(uint256): reduces reserve totals and sends tokens to the reserved address
onlyMarketManager partialLiquidationUser: settles a delinquent borrower and updates liquidator/borrower storage amounts
onlyMarketManager partialLiquidationUserReward: transfers seized collateral to the liquidator via _transfer
onlyOwner setCircuitBreakWithOwner(bool): writes the circuit breaker flag into handler storage
onlyMarketManager setCircuitBreaker(bool): writes the circuit breaker flag into handler storage
onlyOwner ownershipTransfer(address payable): overwrites the owner state variable
external applyInterest(address): public entry point returning the refreshed user amounts
internal _applyInterest(address): runs new-customer check, first-action check and interest update
internal _updateInterestAmount(address): calls the interest model and pushes new EXR/amounts to storage
internal _setAmountReflectInterest: computes new totals and writes them plus reserved amount deltas
internal _checkNewCustomer(address): lazily initializes user EXR values and marks the user as accessed
internal _checkFirstAction(): block-delta based check that syncs blocks and action EXR
internal _transfer(address payable,uint256): converts unified amount and sends underlying tokens to a user
internal _transferFrom(address payable,uint256): converts unified amount and pulls underlying tokens from a user
internal conversion from unified decimals to underlying token decimals
internal conversion from underlying token decimals to unified decimals

internal view cap for a single withdraw action against deposit, request and collateral

_transfer calls erc20Instance.transfer and ignores the return value, so a failing or hooking token silently breaks accounting

normalization_plan.reason: deposit amount argument is only meaningful as the input amount of the deposit flow, so it collapses into the deposit function node
flag only selects an internal branch of deposit and carries no independent state meaning
userAddr is the msg.sender-derived receiver of the deposit accounting and merges into deposit
newOwner is the value assigned to owner by ownershipTransfer and has no standalone role
delinquentBorrower only identifies the target account of the liquidation performed by partialLiquidationUser
liquidator is the benefit receiver of partialLiquidationUserReward and is bound to that function
_emergency is simply forwarded into the circuit breaker storage write done by setCircuitBreaker
adjustedAmount is the withdraw cap result and has no existence outside the withdraw flow
requestedAmount is only the upper bound argument of the borrow cap helper and merges into it
userAddr is the account initialized by _checkNewCustomer and has no other semantic role
